question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**forth**" means **onward in time**, place, or order, or out from a starting point and forward or into view.
 
• In the context of the sentence,** "I went forth softly"** suggests that the person proceeded gently or quietly.
 
• The other options: "**onward**", "**forward**", and "**before**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** I thought he would be glad if I came upon him with his breakfast, in that unexpected manner, so I went forth__ softly and touched him on the shoulder.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Onward (आगे)**: means in a continuing forward direction; ahead.
 
• **Forward (आगे की ओर)**: means in the direction that one is facing or traveling; toward the front.
 
• **Before (पहले)**: means during the period of time preceding (a particular event, date, or time).
